by: Blind reader, from the synthetic STEP 7 FBD network build-records/figure/10-two-conveyors/tank-alarm.png, never seeing a builder file
doubts: Image is 1040x640 px; centres are estimated by eye, so positions may be off by a few pixels.

An fbd-in has no drawn body, only its printed name and the start of its line; its 'at' is taken as the left end of the line (x of about 160 px, level with the name), which is a guess at where the body is meant to sit.

The '>=1' box has three input lines (Flow at y of about 80 px, the top '&' output at about 158 px, the bottom '&' output at about 240 px), so it is read as fbd-or3; the Flow input carries a negation circle (in1).
The top '&' box has a negation circle on its lower input (Valve, in2); the bottom '&' box has one on its upper input (the second Pump, in1).
Pump is printed twice (rows at y of about 240 px and 480 px); the upper one is 'N1 fbd-in Pump' and the lower one 'N1 fbd-in Pump #2'.
The '&' outputs reach the OR box through right-angle doglegs (vertical runs at x of about 520 px and 600 px) that cross nothing and carry no junction dots, so every net is dotted: false.
The '=' box prints 'Alarm' above it and '=' inside; Alarm is taken as its operand.
